rationale.consistency: License headers, module registration, interface guards, humanize sizes and Caddyfile parsing all match siblings; handler uses time.ParseDuration/time.Duration like requestbody rather than caddy.Duration.
rationale.edge_cases: MinRate credit (transferred*1e9) overflows past ~9 GB; per-route subdirective is max_write_chunk, not the required write_max_chunk; HTTP/1 keep-alive leaves a stale write deadline that can break a later no-body response; hard cap anchored at handler start.
rationale.scope: Gratuitously removes request_body read_timeout/write_timeout (Caddyfile and JSON), breaking existing configs; adds unrequested rate args to server Caddyfile options.
rationale.readability: Clear structure and names; IdleDeadline.next is easy to follow; comments are long and cite nginx/Apache but explain non-obvious chunking rationale.
rationale.robustness: Default-on write deadline persists across keep-alive requests with WriteTimeout=0; exported reader/writer panic on nil Ctrl/Logger; unsupported deadlines are handled gracefully; chunked Write/ReadFrom loops terminate correctly.
rationale.maintainability: Single IdleDeadline shared by server and handler avoids duplication; defaults centralized in app.go; handler/server Caddyfile parsing duplicated but small.
